paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: Paper constrains axionlike dark matter coupling to electrons via the 'axion wind' effect. The coupling is expressed as F_a/C_e (decay constant divided by electron coupling factor). Abstract states '95% confidence limit F_a/C_e ≥ 1 × 10^15 eV' but main text and Fig. 5 show 'F_a/C_e > 2 × 10^15 eV' over most of the mass range 10^-23 to 10^-18 eV/c^2. The limit is approximately mass-independent (flat) across this range, with structure near 47 zeV (sidereal bump) and attenuation at highest masses. Local DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is explicitly assumed. The coupling C_e characterizes axion coupling to electron spin.
